caseSnapshot.title: Cart total only reflects first item price
caseSnapshot.description: When two products are added to MiniShop's cart, the total shows only the first item's price instead of the sum of both. For example, adding Keyboard ($10) and Mouse Pad ($20) shows $10.00 instead of $30.00.

steps: Click 'Add to Cart' for Mouse Pad ($20.00)
Observe the cart total displayed on the page
reproduction.actual: Cart total displays $10.00 (only first item price)

patch.summary: Sum every item price multiplied by quantity
patch.reasoning: The recorded cart assertion failed. Source reads only items[0].price; the proposed reduction includes every item and its quantity.
patch.diff:
--- a/apps/minishop/src/store/cartStore.ts
+++ b/apps/minishop/src/store/cartStore.ts
@@ -38,1 +38,1 @@
-  total: () => get().items[0]?.price ?? 0,
+  total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),

caseSnapshot.rootCauseExplanation: The cart total bug originates in cartStore.ts where the total getter reads items[0].price directly instead of summing all item prices. This means the total is always equal to the price of the first item added, regardless of how many additional items are in the cart. Every subsequent product the user adds is silently ignored in the calculation, creating a misleading and incorrect total that could cause users to underpay or lose trust in the application.
